deck: drc_rule_T28_chip (FULL_CHIP, WITH_SEALRING), hierarchical, SELECT CHECK PO.DN.16, PO.R.28, AN.R.79.2m, AN.R.80.2m, MATCH.WARN.1

decision.marker: MATCHING (205;8), normal matching, permanent in the sign-off stream (chip top cell)
decision.basis: DRM T-N28-CL-DR-002 v2.3 8.3.2.3.1.1: normal matching (MATCHING) for two simple identical transistors; high (ANARRAY_H) is 'mismatch within SPICE', medium (ANARRAY_M) 2x SPICE. In the chip deck MATCHING switches on PO.DN.16, PO.R.28 and AN.R.78.1m and clears MATCH.WARN.1; AN.R.79.x / 80.x read only ANARRAY_H / ANARRAY_M.
decision.rejected: Option B (identical-dummy ring, N/P array split, comparator re-layout for ANARRAY_H)

high_matching_evidence.result: AN.R.79.2m on OD density: N array 0.348, P array 0.257 against 0.10
high_matching_evidence.expected_also: AN.R.79.5m (one MOS type per array and its 6 um halo; the P row is 0.23 um from the N array), not run

accepted_risk.statement: MATCH.WARN.1: MOSFET matching may degrade at least 3x when the high/medium array rules are not met. Accepted: up to 3x the SPICE mismatch.
accepted_risk.offset_mc: Layout/results/comparator.md v8 extracted, 200 seeds: sigma 12.05 mV, range -34.7 to +34.1 mV
accepted_risk.at_3x: extreme die about +/-104 mV, 11.6 % of the +/-0.9 V full scale
accepted_risk.consequence: The offset is static and corrected off-chip; the cost is input range, not accuracy.

sign_off.markers: two MATCHING rectangles in the chip top cell over the comparator's N and P arrays (OA PMET_CUT/drawing1 = GDS 205;8); the comparator, the cores and their streams are unchanged
sign_off.lvs_xrc: calibre.lvs and calibre.rcx map no 205;8 (only 205;6 PMET), so device recognition and extraction do not change
